maya: quick ping — can someone take a look at https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/842? small tokenizer tweak for nova-compact-3b (normalizer + vocab index swap). hoping to merge before infra freeze at 17:00 PT. cc @sam @ryan

sam: on it, scheduling a quick glance now. is there a perf/regression benchmark attached?

maya: not yet, i ran local tokenization smoke and unit tests. diff is tiny but wanted eyes on edge cases (whitespace normalization) — pasted the main change below:

```diff
- def normalize(tok):
-     return tok.strip()
+ def normalize(tok):
+     # preserve leading emoji + collapse ambiguous spaces
+     tok = _collapse_space(tok)
+     return tok.strip()
```

ryan: quick question — does this change shift any token ids? the vocab swap note made me pause. if token ids change we need embeddings-mapping update.

maya: good call — no id remap. it's a small replace in the normalizer pipeline only. vocab mapping file unchanged (I double-checked).

jess: i can run the validator job and a short generation smoke on staging. ping me when CI completes.

ci-bot: CI / unit-tests: passed ✅ (linux, py38, tokenizer-tests)

sam: looked through — lgtm from my side. left one nit about a comment but not blocking.

deploy-bot: smoke tests (staging): generation sanity checks OK, message length and stop-token tests passed.

maya: thanks all. i'll merge after the small comment fix and bump the changelog. merging window still clear before 17:00 PT. :thumbsup:

ryan: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

maya: will follow up if any rollout flags needed.
